features.name: v1_v2_ratio
features.description: Ratio of V1 to V2, providing a relative scale between these two continuous measurements, smoothed by a small constant to prevent division by zero.
features.expected_model_benefit: Linear SVMs benefit from ratio features that capture the interaction and relative magnitude of two variables in a single continuous dimension.

features.name: v8_v30_diff
features.description: Difference between V8 and V30, capturing the linear divergence between these two high-variance features.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a direct linear projection that an SVM can easily weight to find an optimal separating hyperplane.

features.name: v15_v39_sum
features.description: Sum of V15 and V39, creating a composite magnitude feature from two similarly scaled variables.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates correlated or additive effects into a single smooth feature, reducing dimensionality and improving margin stability.

features.name: v12_magnitude
features.description: Absolute value of V12, transforming a feature with both positive and negative values into a pure magnitude scale.
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows the linear model to capture symmetric effects around zero without needing a non-linear kernel.

features.name: v31_log_transform
features.description: Logarithmic transformation of V31 to compress its long tail and reduce the impact of extreme outliers.
features.expected_model_benefit: Linear SVMs are sensitive to outliers; log-transforming skewed features helps regularize the feature space and stabilize the decision boundary.

features.name: v36_v13_ratio
features.description: Ratio of V36 to V13, capturing the proportional relationship between these two continuous features.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a smooth, continuous interaction term that can be linearly weighted by the SVM.

features.name: v8_standardized_approx
features.description: Approximate standardization of V8 using its training set mean and standard deviation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Standardized features ensure that the SVM margin is not dominated by features with arbitrarily large scales.

features.name: v30_capped
features.description: V30 capped at an upper bound of 30.0 to mitigate the effect of extreme high values.
features.expected_model_benefit: Prevents large outlier values from disproportionately influencing the SVM's margin and support vectors.

features.name: v1_v15_interaction
features.description: Multiplicative interaction between V1 and V15, scaled down by a factor of 10.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides the linear model with a pre-computed non-linear interaction term, expanding its representational capacity.

features.name: v12_v28_composite
features.description: Weighted linear combination of V12 and V28.
features.expected_model_benefit: Acts as a pre-calculated linear projection that can simplify the optimization landscape for the SVM.

features.name: molecular_complexity_estimate
features.description: Semantic assessment of molecular complexity based on the magnitude and variance of features like V8, V30, and V31.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a holistic, continuous severity measure that captures underlying domain concepts not easily expressed by simple arithmetic.

features.name: structural_stability_index
features.description: Semantic evaluation of structural stability derived from the balance and interplay of features V1, V2, V13, and V36.
features.expected_model_benefit: Offers a normalized, smooth score representing a high-level structural property, ideal for linear margin separation.
